text.description_html:
Brass Accents A06-P0250-US26 Polished Chrome Decorative Trafalgar Door Push Plate 2-3/4" Wide x 11" High

This dramatic cathedral arched rope plate, done in the Georgian style is a reproduction of the Elsley twisted rope plate circa 1880.

Brass Accents provides distinctive craftsmanship with old-world tradition for a lifetime of elegance, hand finished in the USA. They are one of the worlds leading crafters of decorative hot-forged and cast brass door hardware.

Also Available in other finishes Trafalgar Rope Solid Brass Push Plates

Specifications for Brass Accents A06-P0250-US26 Polished Chrome Decorative Trafalgar Push Plate

  • Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Plate Width: 2-3/4"
  • Plate Height: 11"
  • Flat Surface: 2-1/8" x 10-5/16"
  • Material: Cast Brass
  • Comes complete with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.

** Clearance Priced, limited quantities available.

Only (2) Left.
